authentication.transport: Verified Bridge service:read or service:write delegated JWT
authentication.grantIssuer: Desktop Host for foreground defaults; trusted box installation operator for explicit grants
authentication.authorizationMode: Read and write checked per operation; durable worker rechecks expiring grant before claim, while running and at result publication.

foregroundDesktop.request: Use the authenticated desktop Host connection and omit X-Media-Grant. The Host supplies an app-specific credential.
foregroundDesktop.space: Server-bound space, or personal if the platform session has no bound space
foregroundDesktop.requires: Compatible desktop Host, Bridge and media service on a platform-authenticated box connection
foregroundDesktop.legacy: Explicit grants remain supported for existing jobs, templates, image capabilities and background delegations

streaming.createRequest: empty body, authenticated through Bridge using the Host default credential or an explicit grant
streaming.createResponse: id, streamPath, ticket, ticketExpiresAt (Unix seconds), audio, maxFrameBytes, idleTimeoutSeconds, maxDurationSeconds
streaming.connect: WebSocket at streamPath on the same trusted Bridge; no query string
streaming.ticketUse: single use, scoped to this session and inherited grant; request a new session after disconnect

clientMessages.audio: Send even-length nonempty binary PCM frames after ready, paced at capture speed. 100 ms frames contain 3200 bytes.

partial.text: replace the current draft for segmentId

streaming.persistence: The service does not store stream audio or transcripts. File jobs and application archival are independent.
streaming.delegation: Interactive media grants only; background worker delegations cannot request this capability.

upload.continuation: GET job.offset; use full chunks except final chunk; re-send identical acknowledged chunk to recover a lost receipt.

createRequest.requestId: 1–128 characters, scoped to the current grant
createRequest.text: Nonblank UTF-8 text authorized for cloud summarization, up to 32768 bytes
createRequest.templateId: Optional; missing or null selects the default for the current instance

summary.lifecycle: Existing jobs status, result, retry and cancellation; template snapshot is fixed at creation and replay uses the original job.
summary.cloudInput: Submitted text and selected template instructions are sent to the cloud model through the configured device route, with WANX managed cloud routing preferred and direct HTTPS available by operator configuration.
summary.migration: Previously completed local results remain readable. Pending or failed local jobs require explicit resubmission with a new requestId (SUMMARY_CLOUD_RESUBMIT_REQUIRED).

operations: job receipt; same grant + requestId + identical input returns same job
job receipt; failed jobs only, up to three attempts
cancelled; purges result and uploaded bytes
{revoked:true}; permanently revokes this presented instance grant and purges its temporary inputs and results.

image.ocr.access: operator-enabled; internal test until product access approved

image.fingerprint.meaning: 64-bit dHash visual candidate, never a proof of equality

image.labels.score: softmax over supplied labels; requires dataset calibration before display

text.embedding.format: UTF-8 plain text, 1–128 trimmed characters, 1024 bytes maximum
text.embedding.space: L2-normalized Chinese-CLIP text embedding. Compare only to an authorized image.embedding with identical modelSha256 and vector shape.

text.summarize.format: UTF-8 text supplied in the JSON text field
text.summarize.access: Interactive media grant for this application instance. Device installer manages the cloud routing, model, and dedicated credential.

errors.403: denied instance grant, capability or scope
errors.409: offset, request fingerprint or current state conflicts
errors.507: insufficient disk for outstanding input and worker scratch

body.capabilities: Explicit nonempty subset of original capabilities and worker allowlist; audio.transcribe requires explicit opt-in.

issuer.tokenDelivery: Return once with Cache-Control: no-store. Consumer securely provisions the HomeAI service; never store in renderer, HTTP logs or backup.

worker.operations: GET /capabilities and all /jobs operations scoped to this delegation only
worker.limits: Interactive Bearer/instance grant, forwarding headers, non-loopback peers and attempts to re-delegate are denied. Do not register this prefix in Bridge or an external proxy. Household service must also recheck each private input and destination owner before upload or archive.

backgroundDelegation.revoke: DELETE /delegations/{id} as parent; DELETE /internal/media/v1/delegation/self as delegate; parent expiry/revocation invalidates every child and pending output.

queryReuse.scope: same live grant, identical verified input digest, local encoder runtime and model bundle stamp
queryReuse.residency: Linux text-only warm encoder, idle 45 seconds, RSS guard 1536 MiB; other model work evicts it

HEIC/HEIF.discovery: Returned in capability formats only if installed libheif has an HEVC decoder
HEIC/HEIF.source: inputSha256 always hashes the original uploaded container; decoding changes no source bytes
HEIC/HEIF.unsupported: Multi-frame HEIF sequences; paired videos and unsupported originals remain file-library data.
